method: Evidence/rights gates first. Placement blends interest, relevance, novelty, familiarity, consequence, source confidence, originality, visual strength, freshness, radar context and rotation pressure.

feature.headline: How bad is Burlington's crime, really?
feature.deck: Burlington has a reputation for being safe. The best comparable police data shows why that reputation exists, but one detail makes the answer less simple than a single city ranking.
feature.label: Public safety
feature.alt: Chart comparing Halton's Crime Severity Index with selected Ontario police services
feature.credit: Burlington News chart · Statistics Canada / Halton Regional Police Service
feature.storyGoal: Help Burlington readers understand what the best comparable crime data actually says, and where a regional score cannot answer a city-level question.
